summary: A story could repeat sign, upload and a refused finalise without end: a refused upload frees its place and finalise counts only successes, so each round cost a full download and a parse.
fix: sign counts the story's upload attempts that ended without a photo (refused, or expired unfinished) over its whole life; at MAX_PHOTOS x 5 it answers 409 too_many_attempts. Successful uploads never count.
